title: Generic visuality of war? How image-generative AI models (mis)represent Russia’s war against Ukraine
reasoning: The paper conducts a comparative audit of image-generative AI models that includes benchmarking the representation of 'religious symbols' (specifically Orthodox churches) and religious identity in the context of the Russia-Ukraine war. It also discusses the ethical implications of how AI models may 'sanitise and homogenise' portrayals of mass violence.
